limitations: POST body cases isolate production transport restoration and EnrollmentControl.signedRequest with a no-op effect. Admission accepts canonical {} but sync/head itself additionally requires head and epoch.

Query ordering and percent encoding are canonicalized in the signed context. Unique query parameters in noncanonical wire order are accepted by the existing protocol; duplicate decoded keys are refused.
